question: Pricing analysis for Linear, Figma and Slack: compare their paid plans for one user, monthly vs yearly billing.
text:
**For one user, the cheapest paid option depends on the product and, for Figma, the seat type.** Prices below are standard USD rates, excluding temporary promotions. Linear’s official pricing page showed annual-billing equivalents but did not state monthly rates; Figma’s official page showed its seat prices but did not clearly distinguish Professional monthly from annual prices in the fetched text. [web:1][web:2][web:3]

| Product | Paid plan | Seat type | Monthly billing | Annual billing (monthly equivalent) |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| Linear | Basic | User | Not stated on the official pricing page | $10/user/month ($120/year) [web:1] |
| Linear | Business | User | Not stated on the official pricing page | $16/user/month ($192/year) [web:1] |
| Linear | Enterprise | User | Custom | Custom; annual billing only [web:1] |
| Figma | Professional | Full | $20/seat/month | $16/seat/month ($192/year) [web:2] |
| Figma | Professional | Dev | $15/seat/month | $12/seat/month ($144/year) [web:2] |
| Figma | Professional | Collab | $5/seat/month | $3/seat/month ($36/year) [web:2] |
| Figma | Organization | Full | Annual billing only | $55/seat/month ($660/year) [web:2] |
| Figma | Organization | Dev | Annual billing only | $25/seat/month ($300/year) [web:2] |
| Figma | Organization | Collab | Annual billing only | $5/seat/month ($60/year) [web:2] |
| Figma | Enterprise | Full | Annual billing only | $90/seat/month ($1,080/year) [web:2] |
| Figma | Enterprise | Dev | Annual billing only | $35/seat/month ($420/year) [web:2] |
| Figma | Enterprise | Collab | Annual billing only | $5/seat/month ($60/year) [web:2] |
| Slack | Pro | User | $8.75/user/month | $7.25/user/month ($87/year) [web:3] |
| Slack | Business+ | User | $18/user/month | $15/user/month ($180/year) [web:3] |
| Slack | Enterprise+ | User | Contact sales | Contact sales; public price not listed [web:3] |

**Quick comparison:** Slack Pro is $1.50 less per month on annual billing than monthly billing; Business+ is $3 less. Figma’s Professional seat rates also vary by seat type, and Organization and Enterprise are annual-only. Linear’s public page lists Basic and Business annual equivalents; it does not provide monthly-billing prices there. [web:1][web:2][web:3]
